language_task: Put the spoon in the drawer.
outcome_evidence: The spoon initially lies on the table beside the blue plate (frame 0, image and left_ego_image). The robot closes its fingers around the spoon handle and lifts it from the table (frames 68–90, wrist_image and image), then carries it to the open drawer (frames 110–146, image and wrist_image). It releases the spoon into the drawer at frames 147–150; the spoon is visibly resting inside with the gripper open above it at frames 151–157 (wrist_image). The robot withdraws through frame 178 without an observed failed attempt or unintended side effect.
